Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in its initial analysis and decision-making process. In Step 1, the Planner correctly identified that the Sun is the primary source of light but then incorrectly expanded the definition of "give off their own light" to include thermal infrared emission and specific phenomena like auroras or cometary fluorescence as sufficient to validate option D. In standard educational contexts and general astronomy questions of this type, "give off their own light" refers to the emission of visible light (luminosity) versus reflecting light (albedo). The Sun is the only object in the solar system that generates its own visible light; the Moon, planets, and comets are non-luminous and only visible because they reflect sunlight. By conflating thermal radiation (infrared) and transient phenomena with the primary definition of self-illumination, the Planner arrived at the wrong conclusion (D) instead of the correct one (A).
